_source: README.md 'Datasets, provenance and licenses' and docs/data-provenance.md (Oct 18 2026). Full details and rebuild commands are in docs/data-provenance.md.

published.name: rentus-reader-messages
published.what: Renter messages with the exact fields the reader must extract (lease length, move-in date exact or vague, phone, reason, people). 14,000 training rows built from templates and relabeled Google SGD turns; no LLM wrote them.

published.name: rentus-leasing-twins
published.what: Synthetic 'twins' of the owner's real leasing conversations: only the label skeleton is kept, the text is rewritten by Lightning around an invented Nemotron persona, re-verified and privacy-filtered. Also the owner's blind labels and the Gym test tasks (v1 to v3).
published.used_for: The held-out test conversations on the Model tab and the reader test on the owner's labels.

published.name: rentus-reader-qwen3-0.6b
published.what: The reader: Qwen3-0.6B fine-tuned on rentus-reader-messages.
published.used_for: Runs next to the operator on the same GPU and reads every renter reply.
